topic.name: Downloading packeges using pip doesn't work![FIX INCLUDED][FIX DOESN'T WORK ANYMORE]

first_message.rawMarkdown:
Am I the only one?

I always get:

```
WARNING: Retrying (Retry(total=4, connect=None, read=None, redirect=None, status=None)) after connection broken by 'NewConnectionError('<pip._vendor.urllib3.connection.HTTPSConnection object at 0x79967ff024b0>: Failed to establish a new connection: [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution')': /simple/torch/
```

Fixed it by using this trick:  turning internet off and then on
